module.Title: Facility Monitoring Challenge
module.Teaching: Combine sensor lists, device dictionaries, loops, and aggregate calculations into one monitoring summary.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which structure stores each equipment record?
module.PredictionExplanation: Each device is a dictionary inside the equipment list.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair low, high, and average calculations, then include alarmed equipment.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the complete monitoring challenge. Use these exact identifiers: device, equipment, f, print, temperatures. Use these exact values: 1, 125, 18.2, 18.9, 19.1, 20.4, 21.0, 41, 82, "ALARM: {device['name']}", "Average: {sum(temperatures) / len(temperatures)}", False, "Fan 1", "High: {max(temperatures)}", "Low: {min(temperatures)}", "Pump 1", True, "Valve 1", "alarm", "hours", "name".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a pressure dashboard with three devices and a high-pressure alarm report. Use these exact identifiers: device, f, pressures, print. Use these exact values: 1, 41.2, 41.7, 42.0, 55.8, "ALARM: {device['name']}", "Compressor 1", "Dryer 1", False, "Pressure average: {sum(pressures) / len(pressures)}", "Receiver 1", True, "name".
module.PreviewMessage: Chapter 4 complete: the facility monitoring network is established.
